data.title: Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation Schedules Earnings Release and Conference Call for the Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
data.description:
NEW YORK, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation () announced today that it will report earnings for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Friday, November 6, 2026 prior to the opening of the New York Stock Exchange. Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation will hold its webcast/conference call on the same day at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss its third quarter ended September 30, 2026 financial results.

All interested parties are invited to participate via telephone or the live webcast, which will be hosted on a webcast link located on the Home page of the Investor Resources section of our website at http://www.arescre.com. Please visit the website to test your connection before the webcast. Domestic callers can access the conference call by dialing +1 (833) 354-6854. International callers can access the conference call by dialing +1 (785) 838-9343. Please provide passcode ACREQ326. All callers are asked to dial in 10-15 minutes prior to the call so that name and company information can be collected. For interested parties, an archived replay of the call will be available through December 6, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. (Eastern Time) to domestic callers by dialing +1 (800) 753-6121 and to international callers by dialing +1 (402) 220-2676. An archived replay will also be available through December 6, 2026 on a webcast link located on the Home page of the Investor Resources section of our website.

About Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation

Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation (the "Company") is a specialty finance company primarily engaged in directly originating and investing in commercial real estate loans and related investments. Through its national direct origination platform, the Company provides a broad offering of flexible and reliable financing solutions for commercial real estate owners and operators. The Company originates senior mortgage loans, as well as subordinate financings, mezzanine debt and preferred equity, with an emphasis on providing value added financing on a variety of properties located in liquid markets across the United States. Ares Commercial Real Estate Corporation elected and qualified to be taxed as a real estate investment trust and is externally managed by a subsidiary of Ares Management Corporation. For more information, please visit www.arescre.com. The contents of such website are not, and should not be deemed to be, incorporated by reference herein.

data.title: Amy Johnson Appointed President of GDIT
data.description:
RESTON, Va., Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- General Dynamics () announced today that Amy Johnson has been appointed as president of GDIT, effective November 3.

Johnson is a 27-year veteran of General Dynamics Mission Systems, where she held increasingly senior roles in engineering, engineering management and business leadership across cybersecurity, defense electronics, space and intelligence systems, most recently as vice president and general manager for Space, Cyber and Intelligence. She earned bachelor's and master's degrees in computer science and computer systems engineering.

"Amy has a proven track record of leading teams to solve complex and highly technical challenges for our customers," said Phebe Novakovic, CEO of General Dynamics. "I am confident that her dynamic leadership, operational rigor and deep commitment to our values and culture will deliver value to our customers, employees and shareholders."

GDIT delivers digital modernization, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and software development solutions to the U.S. federal government, defense, intelligence agencies and other customers. It is a business unit of General Dynamics, a global aerospace and defense company that offers a broad portfolio of products and services in business aviation; ship construction and repair; land combat vehicles, weapons systems and munitions; and technology products and services. General Dynamics employs more than 120,000 people worldwide and generated $52.6 billion in revenue in 2025. More information is available at gd.com.

SOURCE General Dynamics

data.title: Aeon Strategies Ltd. Announces Anticipated Late Filing of Annual Financial Statements and Application for Management Cease Trade Order
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

TORONTO, ONTARIO – TheNewswire - October 23, 2026 - AEON STRATEGIES LTD. (formerly Cloud3 Ventures Inc.) (CSE: AEON) (OTCQB:CLDVF)(FSE:WQ40) (the “Company” or “Aeon”) announces that it expects to be unable to file its audited annual financial statements for the year ended June 30, 2026, the related management’s discussion and analysis and the related CEO and CFO certifications (collectively, the “Annual Filings”) by the October 28, 2026 filing deadline under Part 4 of National Instrument 51-102 – Continuous Disclosure Obligations and National Instrument 52-109 – Certification of Disclosure in Issuers’ Annual and Interim Filings. The delay is due to (i) the limited availability of the Company’s auditor, Davidson & Company LLP  (the “Auditor”); and (ii) the additional time required to complete audit procedures relating to the Company’s crypto-related investments, which are more complex than in prior years. The Auditor remains engaged, and the Company is working with the Auditor to complete the audit.

The Company has applied to the Ontario Securities Commission, as principal regulator, for a management cease trade order (the “MCTO”) under National Policy 12-203 – Management Cease Trade Orders (“NP 12-203”). If granted, the MCTO will prohibit the Company’s Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer from trading in the Company’s securities until the Annual Filings are filed and the MCTO is revoked. The MCTO generally will not affect the ability of other shareholders to trade in the Company’s listed subordinate voting shares.

The Company currently expects to file the Annual Filings on or before December 4, 2026, and will issue a news release announcing the completion of such filings at that time. In the interim, the Company will comply with the alternative information guidelines set out in NP 12-203. These guidelines require the Company to issue bi-weekly default status reports by way of news release for so long as the Annual Filings remain outstanding.

About Aeon Strategies Ltd.

Aeon Strategies Ltd. (CSE: AEON) is an investment issuer focused on investing in high-potential companies operating across a variety of industries and sectors. The goal of the Company is to generate maximum returns from its investments.

data.title: Wall Street closes lower to end rocky week
data.description:
Key points:
  • Indexes: Dow down 1.23%, S&P 500 down 0.52%, Nasdaq down 0.21%
  • Telecom stocks fall after report of SpaceX wireless carrier talks
  • S&P 500 energy sector climbs, tracking jump in oil prices
  • Investors turn focus to big earnings week, Fed meeting

By Lewis Krauskopf, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi and Ragini Mathur

Wall Street's main indexes closed lower on Friday even as technology shares steadied somewhat to end a turbulent week for the market-driving AI trade, and investors looked ahead to a busy slate of corporate earnings and a Federal Reserve interest-rate policy meeting.

The Nasdaq Composite posted a slim loss a day after the tech-heavy index suffered its biggest one-day drop since June, as concerns flared over financing costs to support heavy AI investment spending. The S&P 500 technology sector posted a 0.35% gain on Friday.

Most S&P 500 sectors fell, however, including declines of well over 1% for the consumer staples and consumer discretionary groups as well as the financials sector.

Next week, about one-third of S&P 500 companies report quarterly results, including Alphabet , Microsoft and Amazon , three AI hyperscalers whose capital spending forecasts will be closely watched on Wall Street.

"There is still fallout from the questioning of the AI trade," said Kristina Hooper, chief market strategist at Man Group. "There's certainly the potential that we see less invested in an AI data center build-out next year than has been projected. So I certainly think that's giving pause."

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 652.82 points, or 1.23%, to 52,215.16; the S&P 500 CBOE:SPX lost 39.75 points, or 0.52%, to 7,623.68 and the Nasdaq Composite lost 53.52 points, or 0.21%, to 25,955.34.

For the week, the S&P 500 fell 0.5% and the Nasdaq dropped 0.7%. The blue-chip Dow rose 0.4%, its third straight weekly gain.

Telecommunications stocks fell, weighing on the communication services sector, after a report that SpaceX was seeking thousands of cell sites for a fourth wireless carrier.

Shares of AT&T and T-Mobile both sank nearly 8% while Verizon shed 1.2%. SpaceX shares rose 1.9%. US cell tower operators gained, with Crown Castle up 9% and American Tower up 4%.

The energy sector rose 2.5%, hitting a record high. Brent crude hit its highest level since late April, after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concern over further disruption to energy supplies from the Middle East.

American Express shares fell 3.7%, weighing on the Dow. The company raised its profit forecast as it also announced plans to eliminate 5% of its workforce.

SLB shares rose 7% after the oilfield services provider beat Wall Street estimates for third-quarter profit.

Data from the University of Michigan showed US consumer sentiment edged down near a record low in October, as rising prices because of the Middle East conflict soured households' views of the economy.

Market focus remains on the earnings season, with robust corporate profit growth underpinning gains for major equity indexes this year. S&P 500 companies are on track to have increased earnings by more than 32% in the third quarter, according to LSEG IBES data.

The Fed is expected to keep interest rates steady when it gives its policy statement on Wednesday, but investors will be eager for clues about whether the US central bank will hike rates at its December meeting. Wall Street is also increasingly focused on the November 3 midterm elections, which will decide control of the US Congress.

Declining issues outnumbered advancers by a 1.72-to-1 ratio on the New York Stock Exchange. On the Nasdaq, declining issues outnumbered advancers by a 1.57-to-1 ratio.

The S&P 500 posted 18 new 52-week highs and 8 new lows while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 74 new highs and 334 new lows.

Volume on US exchanges was 15.4 billion shares, compared with the 17.2 billion average over the last 20 trading days.

data.title: U.S. Stocks Fall as Oil Prices Hit Five-Month High — Update
data.description:
By Katherine Hamilton

Wall Street is continuing its move toward less risky investments, as oil prices climbed to their highest level in five months.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 652.82 points, or 1.23%, to 52215.16. The S&P 500 lost 39.75 points, or 0.52%, to 7623.68 and the Nasdaq Composite slipped 53.52 points, or 0.21%, to 25955.34.

Thursday's selloff of artificial intelligence-related stocks cooled down, allowing the tech-heavy Nasdaq to outperform. Treasury yields rebounded slightly after weathering their biggest one-day decline in more than three years.

The yield on the two-year Treasury gained 0.044 percentage point to 4.680%. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note rose 0.110 percentage point to 4.987% and the yield on the 30-year bond added 0.028 percentage point to 5.314%.

The Brent crude oil rose 3.1% to $116.72, its highest point since April, after Iran promised to retaliate if the U.S. and Israel restart their air strikes. Iran said it would respond with strikes not only on U.S. military bases, but also on airports, pipelines and civilian targets in the Persian Gulf. The energy sector led gains in the S&P 500 following the gains in oil.

Investors are continuing their move to less volatile stocks. So far this month, the consumer staples sector has climbed 9.6%, putting it on pace for its best month in 26 years. Other safe-haven sectors, including utilities and health care, are leading S&P 500 gains this month.

While shareholders fret over oil and tech, consumers are also less positive about the economy. The University of Michigan's monthly consumer-sentiment index showed Americans' mood ticked down in October, putting the metric at its lowest point heading into a major election.

Tech stock losses cooled, but concerns about high costs and barriers to AI growth haven't been completely assuaged. SK Hynix, a South Korean memory-chip maker, canceled its plans for a U.S. public offering, which was expected to fund its manufacturing expansion plans. Lam Research's stock flattened out Friday, but it is down 16% this week after sharing a disappointing outlook that it blamed on supply-chain constraints.

The ICE dollar Index edged higher, as most investors expect the Federal Reserve to hold interest rates steady at next week's meeting, though some are still anticipating a rate hike. Precious metals continued their decline, with gold falling 1.3% to $3,991.10 a troy ounce. Silver lost 1.9% to $53.711 a troy ounce, its lowest settlement since Nov. 26.

French protests have escalated, revolving around dissatisfaction with the cost of living and a widening budget deficit, while the government tries to pass a new fiscal budget.

American Express weighed on the Dow, with shares falling 3.7%. The credit-card company said it was cutting 5% of its workforce, or about 3,500 jobs, citing the need for a more streamlined business.

The energy conglomerate SLB closed up 7.1% after quarterly revenue rose, thanks to some recovery in the company's Middle East business. Expansion in North America, as well as growth in SLB's data-center business, also helped drive sales.

Deckers Outdoor, which makes Hoka and Ugg shoes, cut its sales outlook Thursday night, saying shoppers were getting more cautious. Waning demand for casual shoes is starting to bleed into the performance running sector. Deckers shares declined 4.9% and dragged down shares of rival sneaker companies, including On Holding and Nike.

Write to Katherine Hamilton at katherine.hamilton@wsj.com

data.title: Oil Futures Post Weekly Gains on Middle East Escalation Fears — Market Talk
data.description: Oil futures rise with prospects of conflict escalation in the Middle East increasing concerns about future supply from the region. "Crude oil prices are on the rise as the market rebuilds geopolitical risk premium amid escalatory rhetoric from the U.S./Israel and Iran, raising fears of renewed and potentially even more intense back-and-forth strikes," Mike Castle of StoneX says in a note. WTI settles up 3.8% at $103.27 a barrel for a 4.3% gain on the week. Brent rises 3.1% to $116.72 a barrel, a 6.2% weekly gain and its highest close since April 29. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)

data.title: Badger Meter 3Q 2026: Revenue $235.9M, Net income $35.9M, EPS $1.24— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Badger Meter reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $235.9 million, up 0.1% from a year earlier, while net income rose 2.4% to $35.9 million and diluted EPS increased 4.2% to $1.24. SaaS growth and higher ultrasonic meter volumes supported margin improvement.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $235.9M, compared with $235.7M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 0.1%.
  • Net income was $35.9M, compared with $35.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 2.4%.
  • Diluted EPS was $1.24, compared with $1.19 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 4.2%.

Business Highlights

  • Nine-month sales fell 5.1% to $660.5 million, primarily reflecting uneven timing of utility advanced metering infrastructure projects. Utility water accounted for about 89% of sales.
  • Flow instrumentation sales grew 2.1% in the quarter and 1.3% for the first nine months, supported by demand in water-focused markets.
  • Badger Meter added sewer-monitoring software provider UDlive to its utility water business in May 2026. The acquisition contributed $7.7 million in revenue through September.
  • Electronic-component shortages and tariffs could increase costs or disrupt supply. The company is pursuing alternate sourcing, inventory measures and pricing actions.

Original SEC Filing: BADGER METER INC [ BMI ] - 10-Q - Oct. 23, 2026

data.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Fall on Mild Near-Term Weather — Market Talk
data.description: U.S. natural gas futures extend the week's losses as mild weather for the time of year combines with rising production. "That recovery is bringing supply back into the market just as domestic consumption moves through a milder stretch," Gelber & Associates says in a note. Thursday's storage report that reduced the inventory surplus over the five-year average by 10 Bcf to 35 Bcf was enough to generate a brief recovery, "but it has not changed the broader picture of adequate supply heading into November," the firm adds. "Colder conditions later in the outlook should increase residential and commercial consumption into November, but the intervening mild period gives recovering production more time to replenish inventories." Nymex natural gas settles down 5.6% at $2.64/mmBtu. (anthony.harrup@wsj.com)

data.title: Buy NextEra Energy Stock to Tap Into Power Demand, Says Analyst. Plus, Bending Spoons and 3 More. — Barrons.com
data.description:
NextEra Energy — NEE-NYSE Buy — $80 on Oct. 21 by Melius Research Leverage to significant growth in Florida and numerous other states and a best-in-class power-generation development business in Energy Resources make NextEra a high-quality way to invest in the significant increase in power demand under way in the U.S. Against the data-center hub targets laid out at the 2025 investor conference — 15 gigawatts of new generation for large load by 2035 with a 30 gigawatts upside case — the company's origination channels should comfortably meet and beat both. The diversified mix of natural gas, nuclear, and renewables provides numerous solutions to drive and sustain significant earnings, cash flow, and dividend growth well into the next decade.

In addition, NextEra is absorbing Dominion Energy in an all-stock deal that creates one of the largest energy companies in the U.S. by enterprise value. Power demand is entering its steepest growth cycle in a generation, inflected upward by the artificial-intelligence data-center buildout, electrification, and reshoring. NextEra is structuring itself to be the only company with the balance sheet, supply chain, and operating platform to meet that demand at scale. Target price: $100.

Lithia Motors — LAD-NYSE Buy — $299.53 on Oct. 21 by Seaport Research Partners Lithia Motors reported third-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings per share of $10.34, which compares to our/consensus forecasts of $9.88/$9.70, respectively (although note that roughly three weeks ago, consensus was $10.09). The print was clean, the result of solid all-around performance, particularly in certain areas such as used-vehicle gross profit per unit and selling, general, and administrative expenses as a percentage of gross profit. A low tax rate helped by 18 cents per share, but even adjusting for that, adjusted EPS would have been a strong $10.16.

The other positive driver versus our forecast was a low share count, which helped by 22 cents per share. There were some puts and takes in the quarter, with revenue ahead and gross margins slightly light (although much better than feared), but SG&A was well controlled and relatively stable on a sequential basis. Target price: $490.

Bending Spoons — BSP-Nasdaq Buy — $45.55 on Oct. 21 by StoneX Equity Research While investors will naturally focus on revenue, adjusted operating income, organic growth, and forward guidance, we believe that individual quarterly variations are less determinative of Bending Spoons' long-term thesis than they would be for a traditional SaaS/software company....

Quarterly execution matters, but compounding matters more. We believe that investors should focus on whether Bending Spoons can consistently compound revenue, cash flow, acquisition capacity, and intrinsic value per share over many years rather than allowing the noise of any single quarter to dominate the investment debate....

We reiterate our Buy rating and $50 price target on Bending Spoons ahead of third-quarter 2026 results.

Super Micro Computer — SMCI-Nasdaq Buy — $32.49 on Oct. 21 by Needham Super Micro Computer provided preliminary fiscal first-quarter 2027 results that call for revenue to come in above the high end of its prior guidance. Revenue in the fiscal first quarter is now expected to be $19 billion at the midpoint versus $15 billion previously. The increased revenue outlook is driven by increased demand for AI platforms.

Additionally, Super Micro now expects GAAP and non-GAAP gross margin to be 12.0% to 12.5%, above its prior guide of 10.4% to 10.8%. The better-than-expected GM is attributed to favorable customer and product mix. We continue to expect Super Micro's backlog strength to continue following record levels of more than $60 billion reported last quarter. This momentum is expected to be driven by the ramp of next-generation AI systems.

Our target price remains $46, based on about a seven times price/earnings multiple of our new calendar-year 2028 non-GAAP EPS estimate.

Snowflake — SNOW-NYSE Outperform — $319.61 on Oct. 21 by Evercore ISI Snowflake has pulled back with the broader AI trade over the past week, and we think that's understandable given that Snowflake shares have basically tracked the VanEck Semiconductor exchange-traded fund over the past year (+46% year to date vs. +52% for the ETF).

However, after catching up with Snowflake's CEO recently and a series of discussions with customers and partners, including at Snowflake's recent New York City user conference, we come away from those events feeling good about the beat/raise path for Snowflake heading into the second half, and ultimately into fiscal 2028. At about 14 times enterprise value/calendar-year 2027 sales, we believe the valuation remains attractive for a business pushing toward 40%-plus product growth with steady margin expansion....

When looking ahead to calendar 2027 (fiscal 2028), compares will get tougher starting in the fiscal second quarter, but Street estimates have the potential to move higher....

The bottom line is there's a very practical beat/raise path ahead of Snowflake, and the recent pullback creates an attractive entry point for longer-term investors. Target price: $430.

data.title: PERMIAN BASIN ROYALTY TRUST ANNOUNCES RECORD DATE AND MEETING DATE FOR SPECIAL MEETING TO CONSIDER SOFTVEST PROPOSALS
data.description:
DALLAS, Oct. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Argent Trust Company, as trustee ("Trustee") of the Permian Basin Royalty Trust () ("Permian" or the "Trust"), today announced that it has received a request from SoftVest Advisors, LLC ("SoftVest"), together with other holders of units of beneficial interest ("Units") who collectively with SoftVest own more than 15% of the outstanding Units of the Trust, to call a special meeting ("Special Meeting") of the Trust's Unit holders to be held on November 23, 2026, with a record date of October 13 , 2026. The purpose of the Special Meeting requested by the Unit holders is to present for a vote by the Trust's Unit holders (i) a proposal to approve and adopt the terms of an amendment to the Trust Indenture to effect the Business Combination pursuant to the Combination Agreement (as set forth in the proxy statement / prospectus included in the Form S-4 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission by PBT Land and Minerals, Inc. ("New PBT"), SoftVest, SoftVest, L.P., SoftVest GP I, LLC, and Eric L. Oliver (the "Participants") and declared effective on October 23, 2026, (ii) a proposal to approve and adopt the terms of the PBT Land and Minerals, Inc. Omnibus Incentive Plan, and (iii) a proposal to authorize an adjournment of the Special Meeting, if necessary or appropriate, to permit solicitation of additional proxies in favor of the aforementioned proposals. In accordance with the terms of the Trust's Indenture, the Trustee intends to call the Special Meeting. Additional details regarding the Special Meeting will be set forth in the Trustee's notice of special meeting to be mailed to Unit holders beginning on October 23, 2026 and are also set forth in the Form S-4.

Neither the Trust, nor the Trustee is a party to the Combination Agreement, nor is the Trust or the Trustee soliciting proxies or participating in any offering of securities. The Trustee is not making any recommendation to Trust unitholders as to how to vote with respect to the transaction. The Trust is issuing this press release solely for informational purposes for Trust unitholders. Unitholders are encouraged to read the Form S-4 and the Form S-1 filed by New PBT and declared effective on October 23, 2026 in their entirety and other materials filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission by New PBT and SoftVest for additional information.

IMPORTANT ADDITIONAL INFORMATION AND WHERE TO FIND IT

This press release is not a proxy solicitation. None of the Trust, the Trustee, or its officers or directors, are soliciting proxies in connection with any special meeting of Trust unitholders and are not participants in any solicitation of proxies by the Participants and/or other unitholders in connection with any special meeting. The Trust and the Trustee are not making any offering of securities. The Trustee and the Trust are making this communication for informational purposes only and do not intend to file a proxy statement or registration statement with respect to the proposed transaction.

New PBT has filed (i) a registration statement on Form S-4, which includes a proxy statement relating to a meeting of Trust unitholders and a prospectus of New PBT, and (ii) a Form S-1 registering securities of New PBT with respect to a rights offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Unitholders and other investors are strongly encouraged to read the Form S-4, including the proxy statement/prospectus, the Form S-1, any amendments to the Form S-4 and/or Form S-1, and any other documents filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission when they become available because they will contain important information. Unitholders may obtain a free copy of any Form S-4, proxy statement/prospectus, Form S-1, and any amendments and documents that New PBT or SoftVest files with the SEC from the SEC's website at www.sec.gov.
